error.SCOPE_INVALID: This scope is not available for this chart: choose a team from the list.
error.RANGE_INVALID: This range is not valid: choose whole closed quarters, among the last three.
error.SELF_REVIEW_REFUSED: You cannot review your own sheet.
error.NOT_REVIEWED: This sheet must be reviewed before it is published.
error.VERSION_FROZEN: A published version is frozen and cannot be changed.
error.NOT_AUTHOR: Only the author of the draft can complete it.
error.NOT_DRAFT: This sheet is reviewed: a change would cancel the review.

app.identity.label: Identifier

fiche.form.optional: Optional in the draft; required for the review.
fiche.textRefused.ticket_key: Text refused: it holds what looks like a ticket key. To cite a reference such as a standard, separate its letters and digits with a space (for example "ISO 9001").
fiche.textRefused.email: Text refused: it holds an e-mail address. Name a role instead.
fiche.textRefused.sensitive_name: Text refused: it holds a name that must not appear. Write a role or a generic designation instead.
fiche.complete.title: Complete the draft
fiche.title: Argument sheet
fiche.frozen: Published version, frozen: nothing can be edited.
fiche.verdict.label: Verdict
fiche.verdict.computed: Computed from the data and the thresholds set in advance; nobody enters it.
fiche.finding.h1_above_upper: The median and P85 ratios are both above the upper threshold.
fiche.finding.h1_median_under_lower: The median ratio is under the lower threshold.
fiche.finding.h1_median_in_grey_zone: The median ratio is between the two thresholds: the data neither confirm nor refute.
fiche.finding.h1_p85_not_above_upper: The median ratio is above the upper threshold, the P85 ratio is not: the data do not settle.
fiche.finding.h1_p85_not_readable: The median ratio is above the upper threshold, but the P85 ratio cannot be read (masked or too few items): confirming is not possible.
fiche.finding.h5_within_band: Every compared quarter is within the band and no throughput is under the floor.
fiche.finding.h5_double_band: At least two quarters are outside the double band.
fiche.finding.h5_rising_run: The median cycle time rises over consecutive quarters, beyond the rise allowed.
fiche.finding.h5_under_low_floor: The throughput of a quarter is under the low floor.
fiche.finding.h5_out_of_band: A quarter is outside the band.
fiche.finding.h5_under_floor: The throughput of a quarter is under the floor.
fiche.finding.confirmation_barred: The figures would confirm, but confirming is barred: a competing explanation is not ruled out or not measurable.
fiche.finding.unknown: reason for the verdict not available
fiche.reasons.title: Reasons
fiche.explanations.title: Competing explanations
fiche.reason.defects_without_team: defects carry no team: unplanned work is measured for the product only
fiche.reason.median_insufficient_sample: the median rests on too few items
fiche.reason.p85_insufficient_sample: the P85 rests on too few items
fiche.reason.throughput_masked: throughput masked in a quarter: “confirmed” is not possible
fiche.reason.tasks_without_team_share_ma: share of tasks without a team masked
fiche.reason.no_adopted_threshold: no adopted threshold rules this explanation out
fiche.reason.no_data: the view holds no data for the last closed quarter
